name: Git hosting
discovery_procedure: Use public platform directories APIs and search indexes to discover instances.

name: Package registry
description: Package indexes that distribute source archives or source-bearing packages
discovery_procedure: Use registry catalogs feeds and package search APIs.

name: Notebook hosting
description: Hosted computational notebooks and notebook galleries
discovery_procedure: Use public galleries profile indexes and platform search APIs.

name: Online IDE
description: Public general-purpose browser workspaces with projects files and executable runtimes
discovery_procedure: Use public project indexes search endpoints and sitemap discovery.

name: Code demo hosting
description: Public interactive web demonstrations centered on runnable HTML CSS and JavaScript panels
discovery_procedure: Use public gallery APIs search endpoints and sitemap discovery.

name: Technical publishing
description: Technical blogs documentation and article sites containing code blocks
discovery_procedure: Discover domains through curated lists feeds sitemaps and web search.

name: Discussion forum
description: Public message boards and Q&A posts containing code blocks
discovery_procedure: Use public APIs data dumps site maps and topic search.

name: Code snippet and paste hosting
description: Public code fragments hosted without a full project or repository structure
discovery_procedure: Use public snippet feeds profile indexes and search endpoints.

name: Academic research code
description: Research software and analysis scripts deposited with scholarly outputs
discovery_procedure: Enumerate metadata APIs and filter deposits whose resource type is software or code.

name: Source code archive
description: Long-term archives that preserve public source code from many primary hosts
discovery_procedure: Enumerate archive origin catalogs and content-addressed APIs.

name: Model and ML code hub
description: Machine learning repositories that include source files notebooks or executable application spaces
discovery_procedure: Use public hub APIs and repository search endpoints.

name: Extension marketplace
description: Public browser editor and IDE extensions distributed as code-bearing archives
discovery_procedure: Use marketplace catalogs and version package download APIs.
